paragraphs: (Sallu son of Meshullam, Nehemiah 11:7.) He reports Rabbi Yirmeyah in Beitzah 31a, and Rav Hamnuna in Taanit 7b and Kiddushin 70a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The compressed formulas mean that Rav Salla reports the named teachers. The William Davidson digital texts of Beitzah 31a and Taanit 7b explicitly give Rav Salla reporting Rabbi Yirmeyah and Rav Hamnuna respectively. Kiddushin 70a has Rabbi Salla reporting Rav Hamnuna, a full title difference from Hyman’s Rav heading.

The consulted Nehemiah 11:7 names Sallu son of Meshullam in a longer genealogy; this biblical pointer is separate from the reporting figure in the Talmudic citations. The William Davidson texts of Beitzah 31a and Taanit 7b have Rav Salla reporting Rabbi Yirmeyah and Rav Hamnuna, while Kiddushin 70a has Rabbi Salla reporting Rav Hamnuna. The title difference is retained without joining these references into a single historical identity.
